units.title: Actual densities of the single-block mixtures
units.reader_note: The measure and normalization conclusion is shown first; assumptions, formula proof and exact Lean are folded below.
units.statement: The actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian mixtures have nonnegative measurable Lebesgue-integrable densities of mass one.
units.formula: P_b(dx)=q_b(x)\,dx,\qquad q_b\ge0,\quad q_b\in L^1(dx),\quad\int q_b(x)\,dx=1,\qquad b\in\{-1,+1\}.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including both endpoints and odd dimensions. Every \(n/2\) is a real exponent.

\(\mu\) is the canonical full-orthogonal Haar probability and \(\nu_b=2\mu\!\restriction\{\det O=b\}\). The actual mixture is \(P_b=\nu_b\mathrm{bind}\gamma\), where \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\).

The source density \(p_b\) is determined only Lebesgue-a.e. We choose the literal average \(q_b\) below and certify it by equality of actual measures. No pointwise equality to a different arbitrary source representative is asserted.

Pointwise inner absolute integrability, measurability, matrix positivity, actual mixture probability, outer L1, normalization and the measure identity are proved inside the theorem. None is a caller hypothesis; totalized Bochner integration supplies no fallback value.

notation.text: A is the literal precision; its inverse is covariance. The Euclidean dot product and Lebesgue volume are the same ones used by the canonical actual Gaussian-density producer.
Both signs use the same full O(n) Haar law. The real Bochner average defines the selected representative at every x; its genuine inner L1 is established internally.

steps.title: Fix the actual component and mixture laws
steps.text: The source conditioned priors have mass one. Reuse the canonical actual-mixture construction and the exact Gaussian precision-density identity.
steps.lean: hlaws calls GaussianMixtureLaws.actual_mixture_laws; hpriors calls DeterminantComponents.component_probabilities. hd calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density. The notation P_b is a measure on Euclidean space; no prior or Gaussian law is supplied as an abstract witness.

steps.title: Establish each finite average
steps.text: For every fixed x, O↦p_O(x) is continuous on compact O(n), so it is genuinely absolutely integrable under the finite conditioned prior. This is an explicit internal construction omitted by the paper. It uses continuity/compactness; the independently retained source envelope is another sufficient route, not a theorem this proof calls.
steps.formula: \forall x,\quad O\mapsto p_O(x)\in L^1(\nu_b),\qquad q_b(x)=\int p_O(x)\,d\nu_b(O)\in\mathbb R.
steps.lean: hAc and hpc prove actual joint continuity. hpi applies ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact to each slice and the whole compact group. No nonintegrable-integral default is used.

steps.title: Keep the representatives nonnegative and measurable
steps.text: The component density is nonnegative. Integrating a nonnegative function gives a nonnegative average, and joint measurability gives measurability of the parameterized integral.
steps.lean: hp0 and integral_nonneg give hq0. hqm consumes StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left from the actual joint density.

steps.title: Identify the actual mixture density
steps.text: For any measurable Euclidean event B, first use the actual bind evaluation and actual component law-density identity. Tonelli exchanges nonnegative integration. The proved inner L1 identifies the ENNReal integral with ofReal of the real average.
steps.lean: hmeasure uses Measure.ext, Measure.bind_apply, withDensity_apply, lintegral_lintegral_swap and ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal. Both measures of each nested integral are explicit.

steps.title: Produce genuine outer L1 and mass one
steps.text: Evaluate the actual probability measure at the entire Euclidean space. The nonnegative density integral is exactly one and therefore finite. Measurability and this finite integral give true Bochner L1, followed by the real normalization.
steps.lean: hmassNN is the univ evaluation of hmeasure, using actual mixture probability from hlaws. hqi uses lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable. hmass uses integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae and ENNReal.toReal_one.

steps.title: Consume the actual densities in affinity
steps.text: Apply the produced nonnegativity, measurability, L1 and masses to the actual representatives for both signs. Their square roots lie in L2. Cauchy–Schwarz gives the source initial affinity bound and genuine integrability. The consumer also retains both actual law-density equalities.
steps.lean: Tests/GaussianComplexityMixtureDensities.lean proves this for every source n,κ. memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq and MemLp.integrable_mul give L2/L1; integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg at exponents2,2 gives Cauchy–Schwarz. Real.sqrt_mul identifies the literal source affinity integrand. No arbitrary density/mass premise is exported by the example.

units.lean_statement: Exact preproof sealed signature with only hn and hκ source conditions.
units.lean_proof: The extracted proof below constructs the two actual density representatives, proves their measure equalities and derives genuine mass/L1 internally.
